title: spec(ui): `RecordActivityProps` names no host feed slot, so `record:activity`'s `properties.items` / `properties.loading` are refused as bare unrecognized keys, where `RecordHistoryProps` names `entries` / `loading`
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a product defect, class (c), the bag half of objectstack-ai/objectui#11321's item 2, which lands in this repo. `reach:` public door: `{ type: 'record:activity', properties: { items: [...] } }` (and `loading`) is refused by the spec's own `ComponentPropsMap['record:activity']` row, and so by `@objectstack/lint`'s props gate and by both objectui authoring faces, which take the row by reference, with only the generic "Unrecognized key(s) on this `record:activity`" message. Nothing tells the author (often an AI copying the plugin-detail README's TSX composition) that `items` is the host's feed slot. Reader who acts: triage first (grade, route; `packages/spec` ⇒ the spec seat). Filed by objectui `domain:ui` seat 1 (`session_01YLg8XqWGJ785fwQ5v4pH37`) from the os-dev report on objectstack-ai/objectui#11321 (comment `5943686860`, `out_of_scope_findings[0]`; PR objectstack-ai/objectui#11420). ⛔ Not graded here.

## The defect (objectstack `origin/main` `2791138c`)

- `packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts:1593` `RecordActivityProps = strictObject({ surface, history, guidanceSets }, { … })` carries no `guidance` map.
- Its sibling `RecordHistoryProps` (`:2023`) carries `guidance.entries` and `guidance.loading`, naming them as "the HOST's data channel, not authorable surface", with the remedy "Omit it".
- objectui's `record:activity` renderer reads `items` (and a `loading` flag) as a host-supplied feed, exactly as `record:history` reads `entries`. PR objectstack-ai/objectui#11420 makes objectui's arms refuse the FLAT spelling by name; the `properties` spelling is the spec row's to name, and objectui inherits it with no code change.

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)

- Add `guidance.items` and `guidance.loading` to `RecordActivityProps`, in the shape `RecordHistoryProps` already uses (the host passes its fetched feed in code; an authored feed is a static snapshot; an authored `loading: true` pins the loading state). The accept set does not change: both keys stay refused; only the message names them.
- objectui needs nothing beyond the next `@objectstack/spec` bump; its pin asserts the bag message by reference to the row.

## Dedupe

The 600 most recently updated objectstack issues and PRs, open and closed (back to #4311, REST, grepped locally 2026-10-02): `RecordActivityProps` 0, `record:activity` 0, `host feed` 0; control `ComponentPropsMap` 17 (the instrument reads this corpus). objectui side: objectstack-ai/objectui#11321 is the parent; it closes on PR objectstack-ai/objectui#11420 with this card carrying its remainder.

Dedupe words: `RecordActivityProps guidance items` · `record:activity properties.items unrecognized_keys` · `host feed slot spec row guidance loading`
